evals.name: food-delivery-pledges
evals.prompt: After auditing our food delivery platform, we identified three concerns: (1) gig worker pay transparency, (2) restaurant ranking algorithms favoring chains over independents, (3) surge pricing during emergencies. Help us write concrete design pledges.
evals.expected_output: Specific, measurable pledges for each concern with accountability mechanisms, not vague values but testable commitments tied to product decisions.

evals.name: edtech-data-pledges
evals.prompt: We're an edtech company collecting learning data from K-12 students. Write design pledges covering: what data we collect and why, what we refuse to sell or share, how we handle student privacy when they turn 18, and what we commit to regarding algorithmic fairness in learning recommendations.
evals.expected_output: Pledges with specific data handling commitments, explicit refusals, lifecycle considerations, and fairness criteria — each testable and enforceable.

evals.name: accessibility-pledge
evals.prompt: Our team keeps deprioritizing accessibility. Help us write a design pledge that makes accessibility a non-negotiable commitment — not aspirational, but specific enough to change what we ship.
evals.expected_output: Pledges with concrete standards (WCAG levels), testing requirements, release gate criteria, and accountability for when pledges are broken.
